Subject: Retention/Tracing pricing — advanced dashboards packaging and pilot concession

Hi Samira,

Thanks for the time last week — great to hear more about BrightLane's observability goals as you onboard more inference-heavy workloads. I've attached a short proposal (BrightLane-Observability-Offer.pdf) that lays out:

- Baseline retention: 30 days log/index retention included with the standard plan.
- Extended retention: 90 days at $0.09/GB-month; 180 days quoted as a blended rate for committed usage.
- Tracing: sampled-span ingestion priced at $0.0008/span after a 500k-span monthly included bucket; we recommend a 1% sample for production and 10% for warmup/diagnostics.
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based admin + a $0.02/query surcharge for large ad hoc queries; bundled dashboards include 5 seats + 5k queries/month.

Pilot concession I can propose today: 3-month POC with the following concessions if BrightLane signs the POC SOW by May 21: 50% off extended retention for month 1, waived query surcharge for the first 3 months, and one-time $15k credit to offset trace sampling during ramp. This is conditional on the attached SOW and a small pilot commitment (approx. $12k/month list for the baseline bundle).

Can you confirm if procurement needs an itemized SOW and whether procurement prefers a single consolidated invoice (platform + addons) or separate line items? If you want, I can loop procurement contact into a short call with Marissa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) to go over telemetry sampling and dashboards.

Next steps:
- Confirm procurement contact + preferred invoice layout
- Say yes/no on pilot concession timeline (May 21 sign date)
- We’ll send a redlined SOW and DocuSign link once we align on items above

Thanks,

--
